name: Cosine Annealing
description: Smoothly decreases learning rate from peak to minimum following a cosine curve.
commonUse: Default choice for most LLM training. Works well with warmup.

name: Linear Warmup
description: Ramps learning rate from 0 to target over the first N steps.
commonUse: Almost always used at the start of LLM training. Prevents early instability.

name: Constant
description: Keeps learning rate fixed throughout training.
commonUse: Rarely used for pretraining. Sometimes used for fine-tuning.

name: One-Cycle
description: Ramps up then down in a single cycle. Combines warmup and decay.
commonUse: Sometimes used for fine-tuning. Less common for pretraining.
